title: DIY 20‑Second Video Clip in Under a Minute

scenes.narration: Start by deciding the hook of your 20‑second clip, then browse free stock libraries for short video snippets and royalty‑free tracks that match the mood.
scenes.prompt: A bright home office desk with a laptop open to a free stock footage website, icons of a video camera, music notes, and a notebook with a sketch of a simple storyboard, warm lighting, realistic style
scenes.motion_direction: Slow zoom‑in on the laptop screen

scenes.narration: Import the clips into a free editor, drag them onto the timeline, trim each to the right length, and add a quick fade transition to keep the flow smooth.
scenes.prompt: Generic video editing interface showing a horizontal timeline with three short video thumbnails, a playhead at the center, and a simple fade transition icon, neutral colors, realistic UI mockup
scenes.motion_direction: Horizontal pan from left to right across the timeline

scenes.narration: Export the final cut in vertical 9:16, 1080×1920 resolution, under 30 megabytes, then share directly to Facebook Reels or YouTube Shorts.
scenes.prompt: A modern smartphone held upright showing a vertical video thumbnail with play button, overlay icons for Facebook Reels and YouTube Shorts, soft background, realistic rendering
scenes.motion_direction: Fade‑in of the phone, then slight upward tilt
